Flux Context 图像编辑指南 | Flux Context Image Editing Guide
​​
1. 基础修改 | Basic Modifications​​
​​直接修改:​​
"将汽车颜色改为红色"
"Change the car color to red"
​​保持风格的修改:​​
"改为白天光线效果，同时保持原画作风格"
"Switch to daytime lighting while preserving the painting's original artistic style"
​​
2. 风格转换 | Style Transformations​​
​​原则 | Key Principles:​​
​​明确风格名称:​​
"转换为包豪斯艺术风格"
"Convert to Bauhaus art style"
​​详细特征描述:​​
"改为油画效果，带有明显笔触和厚涂纹理"
"Render as oil painting with visible brushstrokes and thick impasto texture"
​​保留构图完整性:​​
"应用包豪斯美学风格，同时保持原始构图布局"
"Apply Bauhaus aesthetics while retaining the original composition layout"
​​
3. 角色一致性 | Character Consistency​​
​​最佳实践 | Best Practices:​​
​​具体特征描述:​​
"那位黑色齐肩短发的女性" (避免使用代词)
"The woman with shoulder-length black hair" (never use pronouns)
​​保留关键特征:​​
"同时保持完全相同的面部结构、发型和表情"
"while keeping identical facial structure, hairstyle, and emotional expression"
​​分步编辑流程:​​
先修改背景元素，再根据需要调整角色姿势
First modify background elements, then adjust character poses if needed
​​
4. 文本编辑 | Text Editing​​
​​明确标记:​​
"将'joy'替换为'BFL'"
"Replace 'joy' with 'BFL'"
​​格式一致性:​​
"更新文本，同时完全匹配现有字体样式和大小"
"Update text while perfectly matching the existing font style and size"
​​常见问题解决 | Troubleshooting Common Issues​​
​​问题：角色修改过度 | Problem: Over-modified Characters​​
❌ 模糊指令: "把这个人变成维京人"
❌ Vague: "Turn this person into a Viking"
✅ 精确指令: "给角色穿上维京盔甲，同时保持其精确的面部特征和身体比例"
✅ Precise: "Outfit the character in Viking armor while preserving their exact facial features and body proportions"

​​问题：构图改变 | Problem: Disrupted Composition​​
❌ 未控制变化: "把他放到海滩上"
❌ Uncontrolled: "Put him on a beach"
✅ 受控修改: "将背景替换为热带海滩，同时保持主体当前的位置、比例(1.2倍)和坐姿"
✅ Controlled: "Replace background with tropical beach while maintaining the subject's current position, scale (1.2x), and sitting posture"

​​问题：风格应用不准确 | Problem: Inconsistent Stylization​​
❌ 模糊描述: "改成素描效果"
❌ Ambiguous: "Make it sketched"
✅ 技术描述: "转换为0.5mm石墨线条、30°交叉排线、带有细微纸张纹理的技术铅笔绘图"
✅ Technical: "Transform into a technical pencil drawing with 0.5mm graphite lines, 30° cross-hatching, and subtle paper texture visible"

​​核心原则 | Core Command Principles​​
​​精确性​​ - 使用具体数值/名称 (例如："深红色#DC143C"而非"偏红的颜色")
​​Precision​​ – Use exact measurements/names (e.g., "crimson red #DC143C" not "reddish")
​​原子化修改​​ - 将复杂修改拆分为连续步骤 (背景→物体→风格)
​​Atomic Edits​​ – Break complex changes into sequential steps (background→objects→style)
​​明确锚点​​ - 始终声明需要保留的元素 (比例/位置/光线)
​​Explicit Anchors​​ – Always state preserved elements
保持人物一致性，七彩渐变色毛绒玩偶，穿云朵棉花填充的背带裤（保留原版版型），戴彩虹风车帽，用钓竿收集天空中的碎积云，每朵云里都藏着迷你玩偶笑脸"
Change the woman's clothes to a red cheongsam with intricate patterns, have the woman holding a dog in her arms, set the time to dusk, and use backlighting.
